pathology_manifestations: Deep wedge skin biopsy (spanning both the pale central island and the peripheral violaceous ring down into subcutaneous fat): Pathognomonic non-inflammatory obliterative endotheliopathy: Subendothelial smooth muscle cell and myofibroblastic proliferation leading to eccentric or concentric intimal hyperplasia and progressive lumen stenosis/obliteration of medium-to-deep dermis and subcutaneous arterioles (at the dermal-subcutaneous border); strict absence of leukocytoclasia, transmural inflammatory infiltrates, or fibrinoid necrosis of vessel walls (distinguishing it from cutaneous polyarteritis nodosa and leukocytoclastic vasculitis); secondary microvascular luminal thrombosis and erythrocyte extravasation; duplication or fragmentation of the internal elastic lamina without true necrosis
Brain histopathology: Non-inflammatory obliterative arteriopathy of leptomeningeal and penetrating cortical arteries with intimal cushions, subtotal luminal occlusion, and microinfarcts
topics.inclusion_rationale: Characterized by the striking clinical livedo racemosa rash and young-onset ischemic strokes, coupled with multi-territory watershed infarcts and moyamoya-like collateral networks on brain MRI/angiography, and non-inflammatory obliterative arteriopathy on deep skin biopsy.

topics.name: Systemic Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis
clinical_manifestations: Quotidian spiking fevers: characteristic high-spiking daily or twice-daily fevers (temperatures rapidly soaring to >=39°C, typically in the late afternoon/evening) that return rapidly to normal or subnormal levels, accompanied by chills and marked lethargy during spikes

Evanescent salmon-pink rash: transient, non-pruritic, macular or maculopapular salmon-pink erythematous rash that erupts strictly during febrile peaks and rapidly fades as body temperature normalizes; predominantly involves the trunk, neck, and proximal extremities; exhibits Koebner phenomenon (linear urticarial streaks elicited by light mechanical stroking of skin)

Symmetric polyarthritis: progressive inflammatory arthritis involving wrists, knees, ankles, cervical spine, and small joints of the hands and feet, leading to joint effusion, warm boggy swelling, and painful flexion contractures
Systemic reticuloendothelial enlargement: generalized non-tender lymphadenopathy (prominent axillary, cervical, and epitrochlear nodes) and marked hepatosplenomegaly

Severe systemic serositis and Macrophage Activation Syndrome (MAS): acute pleuropericarditis with audible pericardial friction rub; MAS manifests with unremitting fever, petechiae, ecchymoses, mucosal bleeding, jaundice, and central nervous system encephalopathy
radiological_manifestations: Musculoskeletal Plain Radiography of Extremities: Early juxta-articular demineralization, accelerated osseous maturation (premature ossification and early closure of carpal and tarsal growth plates causing microdactyly/brachydactyly); progressive joint space narrowing, periosteal new bone formation, carpal ankylosis ('crowded carpus'), cervical spine apophyseal fusion (especially C2-C3/C3-C4), and mandibular hypoplasia (micrognathia resulting from temporomandibular joint ankylosis)

Musculoskeletal Ultrasonography and MRI: Marked synovial hypertrophy, extensive complex joint effusion with intense Power Doppler hypervascularity, thickened synovial pannus, subchondral bone marrow edema, and progressive articular cartilage erosions

Transthoracic Echocardiography & Chest CT: Pericardial thickening and effusion, bilateral pleural effusions, subsegmental pulmonary consolidations, and diffuse mediastinal/retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy
pathology_manifestations: Synovial Biopsy / Synovial Fluid Examination: Prominent villous hyperplasia of the synovial lining cells, intense sublining vascular proliferation, and dense infiltration by lymphocytes, plasma cells, and histiocytes; synovial fluid exhibits marked sterile inflammatory exudate with leukocytosis (>30,000-50,000/uL, predominantly neutrophils)

Bone Marrow / Lymph Node Aspirate and Biopsy (Pathognomonic in Macrophage Activation Syndrome): Marked hemophagocytosis characterized by activated CD163+/CD68+ mature tissue histiocytes actively engulfing erythrocytes, platelets, leukocytes, and nucleated precursor cells, accompanied by sinusoidal histiocytic hyperplasia and absence of cellular dysplasia
topics.inclusion_rationale: Archetypal childhood autoinflammatory connective tissue disease defined by fever spikes, evanescent salmon-pink rash, and progressive polyarthritis, documented radiologically by cervical ankylosis and micrognathia, and pathologically by synovial pannus and life-threatening bone marrow hemophagocytosis in MAS.

topics.name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
clinical_manifestations: Malar (butterfly) rash with nasolabial sparing
Discoid lupus erythematous (DLE) plaques with follicular plugging and central scarring
Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus (SCLE: annular and papulosquamous forms)
Oral and nasopharyngeal mucosal ulcerations (typically painless, hard palate)
Non-scarring lupus alopecia and scarring discoid alopecia
Livedo reticularis and livedo racemosa
Jaccoud arthropathy (reducible non-erosive joint deformities)
Raynaud phenomenon and digital periungual erythema
radiological_manifestations: Chest CT: Lupus pneumonitis, pleural effusions, pericardial effusion, shrinking lung syndrome with diaphragmatic elevation
Brain MRI: T2/FLAIR hyperintensities in white matter, cerebral vasculitis, cortical infarcts, lupus cerebritis
MSK Plain X-ray: Reducible hand subluxations (ulnar deviation, swan-neck) without osseous erosions (Jaccoud arthropathy)
Musculoskeletal Ultrasound: Synovitis, tenosynovitis without prominent marginal erosions
Renal Ultrasound: Increased cortical echogenicity in advanced lupus nephritis
pathology_manifestations: Renal biopsy (ISN/RPS lupus nephritis classes I-VI: mesangial, focal, diffuse proliferative, membranous, sclerosing)
Direct immunofluorescence (DIF): 'Full-house' granular deposition (IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q) along the glomerular basement membrane or dermo-epidermal junction (lupus band test)
Skin punch biopsy: Vacuolar interface dermatitis, basal layer hydropic degeneration, apoptotic keratinocytes (Civatte bodies), mucin deposition in the reticular dermis
topics.inclusion_rationale: Archetypal systemic autoimmune disease with distinctive mucocutaneous lesions (malar, discoid, SCLE) paired with multi-organ radiological manifestations (CNS lupus on MRI, pleuropulmonary disease on CT, Jaccoud arthropathy on X-ray).

topics.name: Systemic Sclerosis
clinical_manifestations: Sclerodactyly (tightening and induration of the skin of the fingers distal to MCP joints)
Raynaud phenomenon with triphasic color changes (white pallor, blue cyanosis, red rubor)
Digital pitting scars and painful ischemic digital tip ulcers
Facial microstomia with radial perioral furrowing and beaked nose ('mauskopf' facies)
Mucocutaneous telangiectasias (face, lips, oral mucosa, hands)
Calcinosis cutis (chalky, firm subcutaneous nodular calcium deposits)
Tendon friction rubs (palpable or audible crepitus over wrists, ankles, knees)
Nailfold videocapillaroscopy: Enlarged giant capillaries, microhemorrhages, avascular areas
radiological_manifestations: Hand Radiographs: Acro-osteolysis (resorption of the distal tufts of phalanges), subcutaneous soft-tissue calcinosis

Chest HRCT: Non-specific interstitial pneumonia (NSIP) pattern with ground-glass opacities and fine reticulation, subpleural honeycombing (UIP pattern), dilated aperistaltic esophagus ('patulous esophagus')
Barium Esophagram: Esophageal dysmotility, dilated lower esophagus with patulous lower esophageal sphincter
Echocardiography: Elevated pulmonary artery systolic pressure, pericardial effusion, right ventricular hypertrophy
pathology_manifestations: Skin punch biopsy: Marked expansion and hyalinization of the dermis by thick, densely packed collagen bundles running parallel to the epidermis; entrapment of eccrine glands; loss of periadnexal fat; perivascular lymphocytic infiltrates
Vascular histology: Obliterative endarteropathy with concentric intimal proliferation ('onion-skinning') and adventitial fibrosis
topics.inclusion_rationale: High-yield multi-organ disease combining vivid bedside signs (sclerodactyly, microstomia, digital ulcers, calcinosis) with characteristic acro-osteolysis on hand X-rays and NSIP/patulous esophagus on chest HRCT.

topics.name: Takayasu Arteritis
clinical_manifestations: Asymmetric or absent peripheral pulses (especially radial and brachial pulses: 'pulseless disease')
Blood pressure discrepancy (>10 mmHg difference between arms)
Vascular bruits audible over carotid, subclavian, and abdominal aorta
Carotidynia (tenderness over the carotid bifurcations)
Upper extremity ischemic skin pallor, coldness, claudication, and digital gangrene
Erythema nodosum and pyoderma gangrenosum-like cutaneous lesions
radiological_manifestations: CT Angiography / MR Angiography: Circumferential mural thickening of the aorta and its primary branches ('macaroni sign'), smooth segmental tapered stenoses, occlusions, post-stenotic dilations, and saccular/fusiform aneurysms
18F-FDG PET/CT: Intense circumferential glucose uptake within the inflamed aortic arch and branch vessel walls
Color Doppler Ultrasound: Concentric, hypoechoic arterial wall thickening (macaroni sign) in the common carotid and subclavian arteries
pathology_manifestations: Aortic/arterial wall histology: Panarteritis with marked adventitial and medial infiltration of lymphocytes, plasma cells, histiocytes, and multinucleated giant cells; elastic fiber destruction, patchy medial necrosis, and extensive adventitial fibrosis; marked intimal fibrocellular hyperplasia
topics.inclusion_rationale: Classic pulseless disease featuring asymmetric arm ischemia and vascular bruits alongside pathognomonic CTA/MRA concentric aortic wall thickening ('macaroni sign') and branch-vessel stenosis.

topics.name: Thromboangiitis Obliterans
clinical_manifestations: Almost exclusively affects young tobacco smokers (predominantly males under 45–50 years of age)
Severe ischemic rest pain and claudication: Intense burning or aching pain in the instep of the foot (foot claudication / arch pain) or hand, characteristically worsening at night and upon elevation

Digital ischemia, ulceration, and gangrene: Raynaud phenomenon, cold sensitivity, and painful, non-healing ischemic ulcers of the distal toes and fingertips, rapidly progressing to dry gangrene, mummification, and spontaneous autoamputation of phalanges

Superficial thrombophlebitis migrans: Recurrent crops of firm, tender, erythematous, cord-like subcutaneous nodules along the anatomical course of superficial veins in the feet, calves, or forearms that resolve spontaneously over weeks while new lesions appear elsewhere
Diminished or absent distal peripheral pulses (dorsalis pedis, posterior tibial, radial, ulnar) with completely normal and bounding proximal pulses (femoral, popliteal, brachial)
Positive Allen test demonstrating severe occlusion of the ulnar or radial arteries with compromised palmar arch microcirculation
radiological_manifestations: Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA) / CT Angiography / MR Angiography of Upper and Lower Extremities (Imaging Gold Standard): Pathognomonic 'corkscrew collaterals' (Martorell sign): Abundant, highly tortuous, coiled, helical collateral vessels that develop around the sites of arterial occlusion (hypertrophied vasa vasorum bridging occluded segments); segmental, smooth, tapering occlusions and severe luminal stenosis of small- and medium-sized arteries (tibial, peroneal, plantar, radial, ulnar, and digital arteries), with an abrupt cutoff ('tree root' or 'spider web' vascular pattern); striking absence of atherosclerotic plaques, calcifications, atheromatous ulcerations, or proximal aneurysms; proximal arterial tree (aorta, iliac, femoral, popliteal, subclavian, brachial) is entirely normal and widely patent

Arterial Duplex Ultrasonography: Multilevel segmental occlusion in distal arteries with triphasic normal waveforms proximally, flat monophasic or absent flow distally, hypoechoic intraluminal thrombus, and lack of arterial wall calcification

Plain Radiography of Hands and Feet: Resorption of terminal phalangeal tufts (acro-osteolysis), soft-tissue volume loss, bone erosion underlying chronic ischemic ulcers, and autoamputation of distal phalanges without vascular calcification
pathology_manifestations: Arterial and venous histopathology (Surgical resection or amputation specimen): Acute / Subacute phase (Pathognomonic): Highly cellular, occlusive, inflammatory intraluminal thrombus packed with polymorphonuclear leukocytes (often forming central microabscesses), multinucleated histiocytic giant cells, and proliferating endothelial cells; extensive panarteritis and panphlebitis involving all layers of the vessel wall (intima, media, adventitia)

Preserved vascular architecture: Pathognomonic preservation of the internal elastic lamina (intact, non-disrupted elastic lamina without fragmentation or transmural fibrinoid necrosis, distinguishing TAO from systemic necrotizing vasculitides such as polyarteritis nodosa)

Chronic phase: Fibrous organization and recanalization of the occlusive thrombi; dense perivascular adventitial fibrosis encasing and adhering the neurovascular bundle (artery, companion vein, and peripheral nerve) into a solid, unseparable fibrous sheath
topics.inclusion_rationale: Iconic vascular condition in young smokers displaying visible digital gangrene, autoamputation, and thrombophlebitis migrans, verified by pathognomonic 'corkscrew collaterals' on angiography and cellular intraluminal microabscesses with preserved elastic lamina on histology.

topics.name: VEXAS Syndrome
synonyms: Vacuoles, E1 enzyme, X-linked, Autoinflammatory, Somatic syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Exclusively or predominantly affects older adult males (>50 years of age), driven by somatic mutations in the UBA1 gene

Relapsing chondritis: Severe, painful, erythematous swelling and tenderness of the auricular cartilage (auricular chondritis strictly sparing the non-cartilaginous earlobe, identical to relapsing polychondritis), nasal bridge chondritis (leading to saddle-nose deformity), and tracheobronchial cartilage inflammation

Cutaneous lesions: Neutrophilic dermatoses presenting as tender, violaceous, edematous plaques and nodules (Sweet syndrome-like eruptions), cutaneous vasculitis with palpable purpura, periorbital edema and erythema, and painful indurated injection-site reactions

Hematologic manifestations: Refractory macrocytic anemia (elevated MCV >100 fL), thrombocytopenia, myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS), and severe systemic inflammation with marked elevations in ESR and CRP
Thromboembolic events: High incidence of recurrent deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in upper and lower extremities, pulmonary embolism, and superficial migratory thrombophlebitis
Systemic and ocular features: High spiking daily fevers, profound weight loss, scleritis, episcleritis, and periorbital edema
radiological_manifestations: High-Resolution Chest CT: Recurrent, bilateral pulmonary infiltrates: multifocal ground-glass opacities, dependent lung consolidations, interlobular septal thickening, 'crazy-paving' pattern, and tree-in-bud nodular opacities reflecting neutrophilic alveolitis; bilateral pleural effusions; mediastinal and hilar lymphadenopathy

Neck and Facial CT / MRI: Prominent soft-tissue thickening, edema, and intense contrast enhancement along the auricular cartilage and nasal septal cartilage; retro-orbital fat stranding and extraocular muscle thickening

Venous Duplex Ultrasonography: Extensive occlusive and non-occlusive deep vein thrombosis (femoral, popliteal, brachial, jugular veins) and superficial thrombophlebitis with luminal distension and lack of compressibility

Tracheobronchial CT / Dynamic Expiratory CT: Concentric thickening and enhancement of the anterior and lateral cartilaginous walls of the trachea and mainstem bronchi, with classic sparing of the posterior membranous wall, and dynamic tracheomalacia / airway narrowing
pathology_manifestations: Bone marrow aspirate and biopsy (Gold Standard Pathognomonic Hallmark): Characteristic cytoplasmic vacuoles: Striking, well-demarcated, spherical, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in erythroid and myeloid precursor cells, most prominently in promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and early erythroblasts (pronormoblasts); hypercellular marrow with dyserythropoiesis, ring sideroblasts on Prussian blue iron stain, megaloblastic changes, and atypical megakaryocytes; confirmation via Sanger sequencing or next-generation sequencing demonstrating somatic missense mutations in codon 41 (p.Met41Val, p.Met41Thr, p.Met41Leu) of the UBA1 gene on chromosome Xp11.3

Skin punch biopsy: Dense, band-like or diffuse infiltrate of mature neutrophils throughout the reticular dermis with marked papillary dermal edema (Sweet syndrome-like neutrophilic dermatosis pattern), or leukocytoclastic vasculitis with neutrophilic infiltration of small dermal vessels, karyorrhexis, and fibrin deposition, without evidence of bacterial or fungal infection
topics.inclusion_rationale: Landmark modern autoinflammatory syndrome linking earlobe-sparing chondritis and neutrophilic cutaneous plaques with CT pulmonary infiltrates and pathognomonic cytoplasmic vacuoles in myeloid/erythroid precursors on bone marrow examination.

topics.name: Williams Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Elfin facies: periorbital fullness, stellate iris, wide mouth, full lips, and a long philtrum, photographed at several ages
Supravalvular aortic stenosis murmur with unequal arm pulses when the arch branches are involved
Friendly social phenotype is not an image; the gallery is the facies plus the outflow lesion
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography and CT/MR angiography: hourglass or diffuse supravalvular aortic narrowing, branch pulmonary artery stenoses
Catheter angiography when surgical planning needs arch-branch detail
pathology_manifestations: Aortic media with disorganized elastin in the supravalvular ridge; FISH or chromosomal microarray confirms the 7q11.23 deletion
topics.inclusion_rationale: Syndrome with a photographable face and a characteristic supravalvular aortic and pulmonary arterial imaging phenotype.

topics.name: Holt-Oram Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Radial-ray limb reduction: absent or triphalangeal thumb, radial club hand, photographed beside the contralateral limb
Shoulder girdle restriction and a narrow shoulder contour
radiological_manifestations: Hand and forearm radiographs: absent or hypoplastic radius and thumb, carpal fusions
Echocardiography: atrial or ventricular septal defect, sometimes conduction disease on ECG rather than a photo
pathology_manifestations: TBX5-related developmental field defect; septal defect tissue is not specific, so the diagnostic image pair is the limb radiograph plus echocardiography
topics.inclusion_rationale: Heart-hand syndrome whose limb photographs and radiographs are as characteristic as the septal defect.

topics.name: Loeys-Dietz Syndrome
topics.subspecialty: Aortic Diseases & Heritable Connective Tissue Disease
clinical_manifestations: Hypertelorism, bifid uvula or cleft palate, and translucent skin with visible veins
Craniosynostosis contour and joint laxity in the photographed child
Arterial tortuosity may present as a pulsatile neck or abdominal mass
radiological_manifestations: CT or MR angiography: aggressive aortic root aneurysm and marked cervical/visceral arterial tortuosity at a young age
Comparison with Marfan is the lack of ectopia lentis and the presence of bifid uvula
pathology_manifestations: Aortic media with fragmentation; genetic testing of TGF-beta pathway genes confirms the subtype
topics.inclusion_rationale: Aggressive aortopathy with a photographable craniofacial and uvula phenotype, distinct from Marfan syndrome.

topics.name: Carcinoid Heart Disease
clinical_manifestations: Flushing of the face and upper trunk during a carcinoid spell, distinct from the gastrointestinal primary
Right-sided heart-failure signs: edema, pulsatile liver, and a pulmonic or tricuspid murmur
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography: thickened, retracted, fixed tricuspid leaflets with severe regurgitation and pulmonary valve stenosis
Ga-68 DOTATATE PET localizes the neuroendocrine primary but is not the valvular image
pathology_manifestations: Right-sided valvular plaques of smooth-muscle cells in a myxoid matrix on the ventricular side of the tricuspid valve
topics.inclusion_rationale: Valvular disease with both a photographable flush and a pathognomonic echo appearance, kept separate from the gastrointestinal neuroendocrine primary.

topics.name: Mycosis Fungoides
clinical_manifestations: Patch stage: bathing-suit distribution of scaly, atrophic, wrinkled patches
Plaque and tumor stage: infiltrated arcuate plaques and ulcerated nodules
Poikiloderma and a wrinkled epidermis in long-standing patches
radiological_manifestations: CT or PET only when staging nodes or viscera; the diagnostic images are clinical and histologic
pathology_manifestations: Epidermotropic atypical CD4 lymphocytes, Pautrier microabscesses, and a band-like dermal infiltrate
topics.inclusion_rationale: Cutaneous lymphoma whose stage photographs and skin biopsy are the image library, not a single rash type.

topics.name: Basal Cell Carcinoma
clinical_manifestations: Pearly rolled-border papule with telangiectasias on sun-exposed skin
Ulcerated rodent ulcer and the scar-like morpheaform plaque
Pigmented and superficial variants on dermoscopy
radiological_manifestations: Imaging is reserved for neglected perineural or orbital invasion and is not required for the usual gallery
pathology_manifestations: Basaloid tumor islands with peripheral palisading and retraction artifact
topics.inclusion_rationale: The most photographed cutaneous malignancy, with clinical, dermoscopic, and histologic images.

topics.name: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma
synonyms: Marjolin ulcer when arising in a scar
clinical_manifestations: Hyperkeratotic, crateriform nodule on sun-damaged skin
Marjolin ulcer in a burn scar or chronic osteomyelitis sinus
Keratoacanthoma-like dome with a central keratin plug
radiological_manifestations: Regional nodal ultrasound or CT when a high-risk tumor is staged
pathology_manifestations: Invasive atypical keratinocytes, keratin pearls, and solar elastosis in the adjacent dermis
topics.inclusion_rationale: Keratinocyte cancer with ulcer and keratosis photographs plus a standard histologic image.

topics.name: Darier Disease
clinical_manifestations: Greasy hyperkeratotic papules in seborrheic areas, coalescing into plaques
Nail dystrophy with red and white longitudinal bands and V-shaped nicks
Palmar pits and cobblestone oral papules
radiological_manifestations: No disease-specific radiology; nail and oral photographs carry the non-skin sites
pathology_manifestations: Acantholytic dyskeratosis with corps ronds and grains
topics.inclusion_rationale: Genodermatosis identified by the seborrheic papules, pathognomonic nails, and acantholytic histology.

topics.name: Hailey-Hailey Disease
clinical_manifestations: Macerated, fissured plaques in the neck, axillae, and groin with a soggy scale crust
Flare photographs after friction, heat, or secondary infection
radiological_manifestations: No radiology; intertriginous photographs and histology define the topic
pathology_manifestations: Dilapidated brick wall full-thickness acantholysis, distinguishing it from pemphigus vulgaris
topics.inclusion_rationale: Inherited blistering disease with a recognizable intertriginous photograph and a named histologic pattern.

topics.name: Lamellar Ichthyosis
clinical_manifestations: Collodion membrane in the newborn, then large plate-like brown scales
Ectropion and eclabium photographs
Palmoplantar keratoderma
radiological_manifestations: No diagnostic radiology; the neonatal and scale photographs are the gallery
pathology_manifestations: Compact orthohyperkeratosis without the epidermolytic change of epidermolytic ichthyosis
topics.inclusion_rationale: Congenital ichthyosis with unmistakable neonatal and plate-scale photographs, distinct from epidermolytic ichthyosis already indexed.

topics.name: Xeroderma Pigmentosum
clinical_manifestations: Lentigines and poikiloderma on sun-exposed skin of a child
Multiple basal and squamous cell carcinomas and melanoma on the face
Photophobia and conjunctival injection or ocular surface tumors
radiological_manifestations: Neuroimaging only in the De Sanctis-Cacchione neurologic subset
pathology_manifestations: Early keratinocyte atypia and the specific skin cancers that arise in the poikiloderma
topics.inclusion_rationale: DNA-repair genodermatosis whose childhood pigmentary photographs and skin cancers are the image set.

topics.name: Cutaneous Mastocytosis
clinical_manifestations: Red-brown macules and papules on the trunk of a child
Darier sign: wheal and flare photographed after stroking a lesion
Mastocytoma: a solitary yellow-orange plaque that blisters when rubbed
radiological_manifestations: Skeletal survey or abdominal imaging only if systemic mastocytosis is being separated from the cutaneous disease
pathology_manifestations: Dermal mast-cell aggregates highlighted by tryptase and CD117
topics.inclusion_rationale: Mast-cell skin disease with a photographable Darier sign, kept separate from systemic mastocytosis.

topics.name: Lichen Planus
clinical_manifestations: Flat-topped violaceous polygonal papules with Wickham striae on the wrists and ankles
Lacy white buccal network
Nail pterygium and scarring alopecia in lichen planopilaris, filed as sites of the same disease rather than separate topics
radiological_manifestations: No radiology
pathology_manifestations: Band-like lymphocytic interface dermatitis, sawtooth acanthosis, and cytoid bodies
topics.inclusion_rationale: Interface dermatosis with skin, mouth, and nail photographs plus a standard biopsy image.

topics.name: Vitiligo
clinical_manifestations: Depigmented macules with convex borders on the face, hands, and genitals
Wood lamp accentuation of chalk-white patches
Segmental vitiligo stopping at the midline
radiological_manifestations: No radiology; Wood lamp is the imaging adjunct
pathology_manifestations: Absent melanocytes on melan-A or Fontana stain, distinguishing vitiligo from post-inflammatory hypopigmentation
topics.inclusion_rationale: Pigmentary disease whose clinical and Wood-lamp photographs are the library. It is a disease, not a manifestation of another indexed topic.

topics.name: Lichen Sclerosus
clinical_manifestations: Ivory-white atrophic figure-of-eight plaques on the vulva or a sclerotic prepuce
Purpura, fissures, and architectural loss in chronic anogenital disease
Extragenital crinkled porcelain papules on the trunk
radiological_manifestations: No radiology unless urethral stricture is imaged in male disease
pathology_manifestations: Homogenized papillary dermal collagen, follicular plugging, and a lichenoid lymphocytic band
topics.inclusion_rationale: Sclerotic dermatosis with characteristic anogenital photographs and histology.

topics.name: Infantile Hemangioma
clinical_manifestations: Precursor pallor or telangiectatic patch, then a bright red lobulated plaque in infancy
Deep bluish subcutaneous component and later gray involution
Beard distribution and segmental facial lesions that prompt airway or PHACE evaluation, without making those complications separate topics
radiological_manifestations: Ultrasound of a deep component; MRI when a segmental facial lesion is assessed for PHACE
pathology_manifestations: GLUT1-positive capillary lobules, distinguishing infantile hemangioma from vascular malformations
topics.inclusion_rationale: Infantile vascular tumor with a predictable photographic life cycle and a confirming immunostain.

topics.name: Primary Adrenal Insufficiency
clinical_manifestations: Diffuse bronze hyperpigmentation, darker in scars, palmar creases, and the buccal mucosa
Postural hypotension and salt craving are clinical but not the image; the photograph is the pigment
radiological_manifestations: CT: small atrophic adrenals in autoimmune disease, or calcified enlarged adrenals in tuberculous Addison disease
The calcified-adrenal film is the classic radiographic companion
pathology_manifestations: Lymphocytic adrenalitis, or granulomatous destruction when tuberculosis is the cause
topics.inclusion_rationale: Adrenal failure with a photographable pigmentary phenotype. Ordinary hypothyroidism and diabetes remain excluded.

topics.name: Turner Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Webbed neck, low hairline, shield chest, and cubitus valgus
Lymphedema of the hands and feet in the newborn
Short stature documented on the growth chart is not the image; the habitus is
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography or cardiac MRI: bicuspid aortic valve and coarctation
Renal ultrasound: horseshoe kidney
pathology_manifestations: Streak gonads on histology when gonadectomy tissue is available; karyotype is the confirming test
topics.inclusion_rationale: Chromosomal syndrome with a photographic habitus and coarctation or bicuspid-valve imaging.

topics.name: Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia Type 2A
clinical_manifestations: A firm thyroid nodule of medullary carcinoma, sometimes with cervical nodes
Cutaneous lichen amyloidosis over the upper back in a subset of RET kindreds
Paroxysmal hypertension is not photographed; the nodule and amyloidosis plaque are
radiological_manifestations: Thyroid ultrasound and calcitonin-guided staging CT
Adrenal CT or MIBG for pheochromocytoma before thyroidectomy
pathology_manifestations: Amyloid-rich C-cell carcinoma staining for calcitonin; adrenal pheochromocytoma in the same patient
topics.inclusion_rationale: Tumor syndrome with a thyroid mass, occasional photographic lichen amyloidosis, and paired adrenal imaging. Distinct from MEN2B already indexed.

topics.name: Eosinophilic Esophagitis
clinical_manifestations: Food impaction history is clinical; the image is endoscopic, not an external photograph
Endoscopy: trachealization, longitudinal furrows, white exudates, and a narrow esophagus
radiological_manifestations: Barium esophagram: a long narrow-caliber esophagus or a ringed feline esophagus
pathology_manifestations: Esophageal eosinophilia at least 15 per high-power field with eosinophil microabscesses, after excluding reflux as the sole cause
topics.inclusion_rationale: Esophageal disease defined by endoscopic and barium images plus a biopsy threshold. Not a manifestation of a broader indexed disease.

topics.name: Intestinal Amebiasis
clinical_manifestations: Colonoscopy: flask-shaped ulcers with intervening normal mucosa
Ameboma as a cecal mass mimic; fulminant colitis with a toxic appearance is the severe end, not a separate topic
radiological_manifestations: CT: right-sided colitis or a cecal ameboma; liver abscess is not re-listed here because amebic liver abscess is already a topic
pathology_manifestations: Trophozoites with ingested erythrocytes on stool or ulcer biopsy, PAS-positive
topics.inclusion_rationale: Endoscopic ulcerative colitis look-alike with a specific parasite image. Liver abscess stays its own indexed topic because the image set is different.

topics.name: Hepatocellular Carcinoma
clinical_manifestations: A hard irregular liver, sometimes with a bruit
Paraneoplastic photographs when present: pityriasis rotunda or sudden porphyria-like skin fragility are uncommon and not required
The usual gallery is arterial-phase imaging rather than an external photo
radiological_manifestations: Multiphase CT or MRI: arterial hyperenhancement and portal venous washout
LI-RADS features in a cirrhotic liver
pathology_manifestations: Trabecular hepatocyte tumor, bile production, and a glypican-3 immunostain
topics.inclusion_rationale: Hepatic malignancy with a pathognomonic enhancement pattern and a histologic image. Decompensated cirrhosis remains a separate topic.

topics.name: Hemophilia A
clinical_manifestations: Acute hemarthrosis: a warm swollen knee or elbow photographed before chronic arthropathy
Intramuscular hematoma and prolonged bleeding after minor trauma
Chronic arthropathy is a complication and is not a separate topic
radiological_manifestations: Joint radiographs or MRI once hemophilic arthropathy develops; ultrasound of an acute hemarthrosis
pathology_manifestations: No diagnostic tissue pattern; the factor VIII assay is the laboratory image companion, and synovium shows hemosiderin only late
topics.inclusion_rationale: Bleeding disease with acute joint and soft-tissue photographs. The arthropathy manifestation was removed as its own topic.

topics.name: Immune Thrombocytopenia
clinical_manifestations: Dependent petechiae and wet purpura on the buccal mucosa
Scattered ecchymoses without the retiform pattern of vasculitis
radiological_manifestations: No diagnostic radiology; splenic size is normal, which separates it from infiltrative splenomegaly on ultrasound
pathology_manifestations: Increased marrow megakaryocytes if biopsied; skin biopsy is not diagnostic and is used only to exclude vasculitis
topics.inclusion_rationale: Platelet disorder whose petechial and mucosal photographs are the clinical image, distinct from TTP.

topics.name: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis
clinical_manifestations: A chronic crateriform ulcer with a rolled edge on an exposed site
Mucocutaneous disease: destructive nasal and lip ulcers, filed as the mucosal site of the same infection
radiological_manifestations: No routine radiology; facial CT only for destructive mucocutaneous bone loss
pathology_manifestations: Dermal amastigotes in macrophages on Giemsa or biopsy
topics.inclusion_rationale: Protozoal ulcer with a classic clinical photograph and a visible parasite.

topics.name: Herpes Zoster
clinical_manifestations: Dermatomal vesicles on an erythematous base that do not cross the midline
Herpes zoster ophthalmicus with a Hutchinson sign on the nose
Disseminated zoster in an immunocompromised patient remains the same disease
radiological_manifestations: MRI only for the rare zoster myelitis or vasculopathy complication, which is not a separate topic
pathology_manifestations: Multinucleated keratinocytes and acantholysis; PCR of vesicle fluid confirms VZV
topics.inclusion_rationale: Reactivation infection with a dermatomal photograph. Postherpetic neuralgia is a symptom and is not a topic.

topics.name: Mpox
clinical_manifestations: Firm deep-seated umbilicated pustules in the same stage across a region
Anogenital and oral mucosal lesions in the 2022 clade pattern
Palmar and plantar pustules
radiological_manifestations: No routine imaging; proctitis MRI is a complication, not the topic
pathology_manifestations: Orthopox viral cytopathic effect; PCR distinguishes mpox from varicella
topics.inclusion_rationale: Poxvirus whose umbilicated pustule photographs are the diagnostic image.

topics.name: Measles
clinical_manifestations: Koplik spots on the buccal mucosa opposite the molars
Cephalocaudal morbilliform eruption that becomes confluent on the face
Conjunctivitis and a toxic febrile appearance
radiological_manifestations: Chest radiograph only if pneumonia complicates the illness; the gallery is the spots and rash
pathology_manifestations: Warthin-Finkeldey giant cells in lymphoid tissue when biopsied, which is uncommon
topics.inclusion_rationale: Viral exanthem with two photographable hallmarks, Koplik spots and the confluent rash.

topics.name: Respiratory Diphtheria
clinical_manifestations: Adherent gray pharyngeal pseudomembrane that bleeds when lifted
Bull neck from cervical edema
Cutaneous diphtheria ulcers are a site of the same infection, not a separate topic
radiological_manifestations: Neck soft-tissue radiograph or endoscopy images of airway membrane when intubation is considered
pathology_manifestations: Toxin-producing Corynebacterium diphtheriae on culture; the membrane is necrotic epithelium and fibrin
topics.inclusion_rationale: Toxin disease with a membrane photograph and a bull-neck photograph.

topics.name: Yaws
clinical_manifestations: Primary mother yaw: a papillomatous raspberry lesion
Secondary disseminated papillomas and palmoplantar keratoderma
Late gangosa nasal destruction and saber tibia, kept as late sites of yaws rather than new topics
radiological_manifestations: Tibial radiograph: periosteal new bone in late osteoperiostitis
pathology_manifestations: Epidermal hyperplasia with treponemes on silver stain; serology crosses with syphilis, so geography and the photograph matter
topics.inclusion_rationale: Endemic treponematosis with papilloma photographs and a late bone film, distinct from venereal syphilis.

topics.name: Orf
clinical_manifestations: A targetoid nodule on a finger after sheep or goat exposure, evolving through macule, target, weeping nodule, and crust
Usually a single lesion on the hand
radiological_manifestations: No radiology
pathology_manifestations: Ballooning keratinocytes and eosinophilic inclusions; parapoxvirus PCR confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: Zoonotic poxvirus with a staged hand photograph.

topics.name: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease
clinical_manifestations: Oval gray vesicles on the palms, soles, and buttocks
Painful oral vesicles and shallow ulcers
Onychomadesis weeks later is a sequela, not a separate topic
radiological_manifestations: No radiology
pathology_manifestations: Reticular degeneration of the epidermis; enterovirus PCR when needed
topics.inclusion_rationale: Enteroviral illness with a distribution-specific vesicle photograph.

topics.name: Anti-GBM Disease
clinical_manifestations: Hemoptysis and diffuse alveolar hemorrhage in a young adult
Rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis is laboratory and urinary, not photographic
radiological_manifestations: Chest radiograph and CT: bilateral alveolar hemorrhage that clears faster than pneumonia
pathology_manifestations: Linear IgG along the glomerular basement membrane on immunofluorescence; lung biopsy shows the same linear pattern
topics.inclusion_rationale: Pulmonary-renal disease whose hemorrhage films and linear immunofluorescence are the images.

topics.name: Prune Belly Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Wrinkled, prune-like abdominal wall in a newborn boy
Bilateral cryptorchidism
Potter-like facies only if severe oligohydramnios occurred
radiological_manifestations: Voiding cystourethrogram and ultrasound: massively dilated ureters, a large bladder, and dysplastic kidneys
pathology_manifestations: Deficient abdominal-wall muscle on resection; renal dysplasia on nephrectomy specimens
topics.inclusion_rationale: Congenital syndrome with an immediate clinical photograph and a dilated-tract imaging set.

topics.name: Bladder Exstrophy
clinical_manifestations: Exposed bladder plate on the lower abdominal wall of a newborn
Divergent rectus muscles and a low-set umbilicus
Epispadias in boys
radiological_manifestations: Pelvic radiograph: wide pubic diastasis
pathology_manifestations: The exposed urothelium is the operative photograph; histology is normal urothelium rather than a tumor
topics.inclusion_rationale: Open-bladder malformation with a delivery-room photograph and pelvic diastasis.

topics.name: X-Linked Adrenoleukodystrophy
clinical_manifestations: Bronze hyperpigmentation when adrenal failure accompanies the cerebral disease
Behavioral change and school failure are not images; the photograph is the pigment plus the MRI
radiological_manifestations: Brain MRI: posterior white-matter demyelination with a leading edge of contrast enhancement, scored by the Loes pattern
pathology_manifestations: Adrenal cortical atrophy; very-long-chain fatty acids and ABCD1 sequencing confirm
topics.inclusion_rationale: Leukodystrophy with a named MRI pattern and, often, Addisonian photographs.

topics.name: Melkersson-Rosenthal Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Recurrent non-pitting lip or facial swelling
Fissured lingua plicata
Recurrent facial palsy, photographed during an attack
radiological_manifestations: MRI may show facial-nerve enhancement during palsy; it is supportive, not defining
pathology_manifestations: Non-caseating granulomas in the lip, overlapping orofacial granulomatosis
topics.inclusion_rationale: Triad with three photographable findings: lip edema, fissured tongue, and facial palsy.

topics.name: Leber Hereditary Optic Neuropathy
clinical_manifestations: Acute painless central vision loss in a young adult, often sequential
Fundus in the acute phase: disc hyperemia and peripapillary telangiectatic microangiopathy
radiological_manifestations: Optical coherence tomography: early retinal-nerve-fiber swelling, then atrophy; MRI excludes compressive and demyelinating mimics
pathology_manifestations: Mitochondrial DNA mutation, most often m.11778G>A; there is no useful nerve biopsy
topics.inclusion_rationale: Mitochondrial optic neuropathy with an acute fundus photograph and OCT, distinct from demyelinating optic neuritis.

topics.name: Primary Congenital Glaucoma
clinical_manifestations: Enlarged cloudy cornea and buphthalmos in an infant
Epiphora, photophobia, and blepharospasm
Haab striae once the cornea clears
radiological_manifestations: Ultrasound biomicroscopy or axial-length ultrasound documents globe enlargement
pathology_manifestations: Trabecular meshwork dysgenesis on gonioscopy photographs; histology is rarely obtained
topics.inclusion_rationale: Infantile glaucoma with a bedside corneal photograph.

topics.name: Acute Angle-Closure Glaucoma
clinical_manifestations: Red eye, mid-dilated oval pupil, and corneal edema
Shallow anterior chamber on slit lamp
The fellow eye often shows a closable angle
radiological_manifestations: Anterior-segment OCT or ultrasound biomicroscopy of iridotrabecular contact
pathology_manifestations: No routine histology; gonioscopy is the clinical image
topics.inclusion_rationale: Acute glaucoma with a recognizable external and slit-lamp photograph, unlike chronic open-angle glaucoma which has no bedside image.

topics.name: Trachoma
clinical_manifestations: Follicular conjunctivitis of the upper tarsus
Herbert pits and Arlt line in healed disease
Trichiasis and corneal opacity from cicatricial entropion
radiological_manifestations: No radiology
pathology_manifestations: Inclusion conjunctivitis with chlamydial inclusions; the WHO sign photographs are the usual gallery
topics.inclusion_rationale: Chronic ocular infection with staged conjunctival and lid photographs.

topics.name: Onchocerciasis
clinical_manifestations: Sclerosing keratitis advancing from the limbus
Chorioretinal atrophy and optic atrophy in river blindness
Onchocercal nodules and leopard-skin depigmentation as the skin site of the same infection
radiological_manifestations: Ultrasound of a nodule is optional; the slit-lamp microfilaria in the anterior chamber is the image
pathology_manifestations: Adult worms in a subcutaneous nodule and microfilariae in the cornea or skin snip
topics.inclusion_rationale: Filarial disease whose corneal, nodule, and skin photographs belong together.

topics.name: Ocular Coloboma
clinical_manifestations: Keyhole iris defect inferonasally
Fundus coloboma as a white inferonasal chorioretinal defect
Microphthalmos when the fissure closure defect is severe
radiological_manifestations: Orbital ultrasound or MRI for associated microphthalmos or cyst
pathology_manifestations: Failure of embryonic fissure closure; histology is not the usual image
topics.inclusion_rationale: Congenital fissure defect with iris and fundus photographs.

topics.name: Peters Anomaly
clinical_manifestations: Central corneal opacity with iris strands to the posterior cornea
Shallow or absent anterior chamber in severe cases
radiological_manifestations: Anterior-segment OCT or ultrasound biomicroscopy of the lens-cornea adhesion
pathology_manifestations: Absent Descemet membrane and endothelium in the corneal leukoma
topics.inclusion_rationale: Anterior-segment malformation with a corneal-opacity photograph.

topics.name: Sympathetic Ophthalmia
clinical_manifestations: Bilateral granulomatous uveitis days to years after penetrating trauma or surgery in one eye
Dalen-Fuchs spots on the fundus
Mutton-fat keratic precipitates
radiological_manifestations: Fluorescein angiography and OCT of the multifocal choroiditis
pathology_manifestations: Diffuse granulomatous uveal inflammation if the exciting eye is enucleated
topics.inclusion_rationale: Bilateral uveitis after trauma, with fundus and slit-lamp photographs.

topics.name: Morning Glory Disc Anomaly
clinical_manifestations: Enlarged funnel-shaped disc with a central glial tuft and radial vessels
Serous retinal detachment in some eyes
radiological_manifestations: MRI or MRA when a basal encephalocele or carotid narrowing is being excluded
pathology_manifestations: No routine histology
topics.inclusion_rationale: Congenital disc anomaly with a named fundus photograph.

topics.name: Chronic Recurrent Multifocal Osteomyelitis
clinical_manifestations: Painful bony swelling, often clavicle, that looks infected but cultures are negative
Palmoplantar pustulosis when it overlaps SAPHO; SAPHO remains a separate rheumatology topic
radiological_manifestations: Radiographs and MRI: multifocal metaphyseal inflammatory lesions, clavicular expansion
Whole-body MRI maps silent sites
pathology_manifestations: Sterile osteitis with neutrophils early and later fibrosis; cultures and histology exclude infection and tumor
topics.inclusion_rationale: Sterile bone inflammation with a clavicular photograph and a multifocal MRI pattern.

topics.name: Pyknodysostosis
clinical_manifestations: Short stature, open fontanelles into adult life, and a small jaw
Fractures after mild trauma and grooved nails
radiological_manifestations: Skeletal survey: osteosclerosis with preserved medullary canals, obtuse mandibular angle, and hypoplastic clavicles
pathology_manifestations: Cathepsin K deficiency; bone histology is dense but not required for the gallery
topics.inclusion_rationale: Sclerosing dysplasia with a facial photograph and a characteristic skeletal survey, distinct from osteopetrosis.

topics.name: Caffey Disease
clinical_manifestations: Irritable infant with a warm, woody soft-tissue swelling over the mandible or a limb
Fever and the swelling resolve, unlike infection
radiological_manifestations: Radiograph: cortical hyperostosis of the mandible, clavicle, or ulna, sparing the phalanges and vertebrae
pathology_manifestations: Subperiosteal new bone and inflammation; biopsy is rarely needed once the film is recognized
topics.inclusion_rationale: Infantile periosteal disease with a mandibular swelling photograph and a named radiographic pattern.

topics.name: Diastrophic Dysplasia
clinical_manifestations: Hitchhiker thumbs, severe clubfoot, and cauliflower ear swelling in the newborn
Short limbs and progressive kyphoscoliosis
radiological_manifestations: Hand and spine radiographs: short first metacarpal, hitchhiker thumb, and cervical kyphosis
pathology_manifestations: SLC26A2-related sulfation defect; ear cartilage shows cystic swelling
topics.inclusion_rationale: Dysplasia with newborn ear, thumb, and foot photographs plus matching radiographs.

topics.name: Dysplasia Epiphysealis Hemimelica
clinical_manifestations: A painless bony lump next to a knee or ankle in a child, on one side of the epiphysis
Limb-length or angular deformity as it enlarges
radiological_manifestations: Radiograph and MRI: an osteocartilaginous overgrowth of one half of the epiphysis, continuous with the bone
pathology_manifestations: Osteochondroma-like cap arising from the epiphysis rather than the metaphysis
topics.inclusion_rationale: Epiphyseal overgrowth with a lump photograph and a half-epiphysis radiograph.

topics.name: Dupuytren Contracture
clinical_manifestations: Palmar nodules and cords with a flexed ring or little finger that cannot flatten on the table
Garrod knuckle pads and plantar nodules as related fibromatosis sites
radiological_manifestations: Radiographs are normal; the photograph and the table-top test are the images
pathology_manifestations: Palmar fascia with myofibroblast nodules
topics.inclusion_rationale: Palmar fibromatosis with a contracture photograph. Included because the clinical image is the diagnosis.

topics.name: Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorder
clinical_manifestations: Short palpebral fissures, smooth philtrum, and a thin upper lip
Growth restriction and microcephaly
radiological_manifestations: Brain MRI: corpus callosum hypoplasia or migration anomalies in the severe end
pathology_manifestations: No diagnostic biopsy; the lip-philtrum guide photograph is the clinical standard
topics.inclusion_rationale: Teratogenic syndrome with a standardized facial photograph.

topics.name: 22q11.2 Deletion Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Hooded eyelids, a bulbous nose tip, small ears, and a small mouth
Overt or submucous cleft palate and nasal regurgitation
Neonatal hypocalcemic tetany is not the image
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography: conotruncal anomalies, especially tetralogy or interrupted aortic arch
Absent thymic shadow on the newborn chest radiograph when the T-cell defect is severe
pathology_manifestations: Thymic hypoplasia if tissue is examined; chromosomal microarray is the confirming test
topics.inclusion_rationale: Microdeletion with a facial photograph, a palate photograph, and a conotruncal imaging set.

topics.name: Stickler Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Flat midface, Pierre Robin sequence, and a small jaw
High myopia and vitreous changes; retinal detachment is a complication, not a separate topic
radiological_manifestations: Spine and joint radiographs: mild epiphyseal dysplasia and platyspondyly
pathology_manifestations: Vitreous photography and COL2A1-spectrum testing; cleft-palate histology is not specific
topics.inclusion_rationale: Collagenopathy with a midface photograph, vitreous findings, and mild skeletal films.

topics.name: Proteus Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Progressive, asymmetric, distorting overgrowth of a limb or digit after birth
Cerebriform connective-tissue nevus of the sole
Epidermal nevi and lipomas in the same mosaic distribution
radiological_manifestations: Radiographs of the affected limb: irregular bony overgrowth; MRI of soft-tissue asymmetry
pathology_manifestations: AKT1 activating mosaic variant; the sole nevus shows collagenous overgrowth
topics.inclusion_rationale: Mosaic overgrowth with a progressive limb photograph and a cerebriform sole.

topics.name: Recurrent Respiratory Papillomatosis
clinical_manifestations: Hoarse child with warty lesions on the vocal cords at laryngoscopy
Stridor when the glottis is obstructed
radiological_manifestations: CT: tracheal or pulmonary cystic papillomas if disease spreads below the larynx
pathology_manifestations: HPV-driven squamous papillomas with koilocytes, usually types 6 and 11
topics.inclusion_rationale: Airway HPV disease whose laryngoscopic photographs are the gallery.

topics.name: Diffuse Panbronchiolitis
clinical_manifestations: Chronic sinusitis with nasal polyps plus productive cough
The external image is the sinus disease; the defining image is the chest CT
radiological_manifestations: HRCT: diffuse centrilobular nodules and tree-in-bud with later bronchiolectasis
pathology_manifestations: Transbronchial biopsy: foamy interstitial macrophages in respiratory bronchioles
topics.inclusion_rationale: East-Asian small-airway disease with sinus photographs, a tree-in-bud CT, and a foamy-macrophage biopsy.

topics.name: Pulmonary Arteriovenous Malformation
clinical_manifestations: Cyanosis, clubbing, and orthodeoxia when shunts are large
Telangiectasias if hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia is the cause; HHT stays a dermatology topic and this is the lung lesion
radiological_manifestations: CT angiography: a peripheral nodule with a feeding artery and draining vein; bubble echo shows intrapulmonary shunt
pathology_manifestations: Dilated vascular channels without a capillary bed on resected lesions
topics.inclusion_rationale: Shunt lesion with clubbing photographs and a feeding-vessel CT sign.

topics.name: Deficiency of Adenosine Deaminase 2
clinical_manifestations: Livedo racemosa and cutaneous nodules from small-vessel vasculitis
Early-onset lacunar strokes, kept as a site of DADA2 rather than a separate stroke topic
Hypogammaglobulinemia is laboratory, not an image
radiological_manifestations: Brain MRI: lacunar infarcts in a child; visceral angiography may mimic polyarteritis nodosa
pathology_manifestations: Non-granulomatous small- and medium-vessel vasculitis; plasma ADA2 activity is low
topics.inclusion_rationale: Monogenic vasculitis with livedo photographs and childhood stroke imaging, distinct from polyarteritis nodosa.

topics.name: Blau Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Tan micropapular rash in an infant
Boggy polyarthritis and camptodactyly
Granulomatous uveitis
radiological_manifestations: Hand radiographs: expanded carpus and camptodactyly; chest imaging is clear, unlike sarcoidosis
pathology_manifestations: Non-caseating granulomas in skin; NOD2 mutation in the nucleotide-binding domain
topics.inclusion_rationale: Infantile granulomatous triad with rash, joint, and eye photographs, separated from adult sarcoidosis by age and genotype.

topics.name: Schnitzler Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Chronic nonpruritic urticarial rash
Bone pain over the iliac crest or tibia
radiological_manifestations: Bone scintigraphy or radiographs: sclerotic bone lesions
pathology_manifestations: Neutrophilic dermal infiltrate without vasculitis; IgM monoclonal protein
topics.inclusion_rationale: Autoinflammatory urticaria with a rash photograph and a sclerotic bone scan.

topics.name: Hypocomplementemic Urticarial Vasculitis
clinical_manifestations: Urticarial wheals that last more than 24 hours and leave purpura or pigment
Angioedema and eye redness from episcleritis or uveitis
radiological_manifestations: Chest CT if obstructive lung disease develops; it is a complication, not a required image
pathology_manifestations: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis on urticarial skin, low complements, and anti-C1q antibodies
topics.inclusion_rationale: Urticarial vasculitis with timed clinical photographs and a vasculitis biopsy, distinct from ordinary urticaria.

topics.name: Infantile-Onset Pompe Disease
clinical_manifestations: Macroglossia, severe hypotonia, and a weak cry in an infant
Hepatomegaly from heart failure rather than storage alone
radiological_manifestations: Chest radiograph: massive cardiomegaly
Echocardiography: thick walls and left-ventricular outflow obstruction
pathology_manifestations: Vacuolated glycogen-filled myocytes on PAS; GAA enzyme activity is deficient
topics.inclusion_rationale: Metabolic cardiomyopathy with a bedside photograph and a cardiomegaly film.

topics.name: Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Gray, shocky neonate as the ductus closes
Weak pulses and a single second heart sound
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography: diminutive left ventricle, aortic atresia or mitral atresia, and a duct-dependent systemic circulation
pathology_manifestations: The surgical specimen shows the hypoplastic left heart; the gallery is the echo and the cyanotic neonate
topics.inclusion_rationale: Duct-dependent left-heart lesion with a clinical shock photograph and a defining echocardiogram.

topics.name: Truncus Arteriosus
clinical_manifestations: Mild cyanosis and heart-failure signs in early infancy
Often a 22q11 face; that syndrome stays its own topic
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography and CT: one arterial trunk overriding a ventricular septal defect, with the pulmonary arteries arising from the trunk
pathology_manifestations: Failure of truncal septation; histology is not the usual image
topics.inclusion_rationale: Cyanotic trunk anomaly with an infant photograph and a single-trunk imaging sign.

topics.name: Tricuspid Atresia
clinical_manifestations: Cyanosis from birth and a single second heart sound
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography: absent tricuspid valve, hypoplastic right ventricle, and an atrial-level right-to-left shunt
ECG left-axis deviation supports the film, it is not a photograph
pathology_manifestations: Atretic right atrioventricular connection on the specimen
topics.inclusion_rationale: Cyanotic lesion with a bedside color change and a missing-valve echocardiogram.

topics.name: Pulmonary Atresia with Intact Ventricular Septum
clinical_manifestations: Duct-dependent deep cyanosis in the newborn
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography: plate-like pulmonary valve atresia, a hypoplastic right ventricle, and sometimes coronary sinusoids
pathology_manifestations: Atretic pulmonary valve on the specimen; coronary fistulas are an imaging finding, not a separate topic
topics.inclusion_rationale: Duct-dependent cyanotic disease with a newborn photograph and a plate-atretic valve on echo.

topics.name: Noonan Syndrome with Multiple Lentigines
clinical_manifestations: Thousands of lentigines and cafe-noir patches
Hypertelorism and low-set ears
Sensorineural deafness is not an image
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography: hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
ECG conduction disease is supportive
pathology_manifestations: Lentigines show basal melanocyte hyperplasia; PTPN11 or RAF1 confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: RASopathy with a lentiginous photograph and hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy imaging. Noonan syndrome itself stays in pediatrics.

topics.name: Double Aortic Arch
clinical_manifestations: Infant stridor and dysphagia that worsen with feeding
The photograph is often the barium swallow rather than the face
radiological_manifestations: Barium esophagram: bilateral and posterior indentations
CT or MR angiography: two arches encircling trachea and esophagus
pathology_manifestations: No diagnostic histology
topics.inclusion_rationale: Vascular ring with a classic esophagram and a CT ring. Stridor alone is not the topic.

topics.name: Aortopulmonary Window
clinical_manifestations: Heart-failure signs and mild cyanosis in infancy from a large runoff
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography and CT: a window between the ascending aorta and the pulmonary trunk, with two separate semilunar valves
pathology_manifestations: Deficient aortopulmonary septum; histology is not the gallery
topics.inclusion_rationale: Congenital window with a runoff photograph of an infant in failure and a CT or echo defect. Distinct from truncus arteriosus.

topics.name: Barth Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Infant boys with dilated cardiomyopathy, neutropenia, and failure to thrive
A characteristic face is mild; the gallery is the heart and the infection-prone child
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography: dilated or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, often with left-ventricular noncompaction as a site rather than a separate topic
pathology_manifestations: Abnormal mitochondria on muscle; TAZ sequencing and elevated 3-methylglutaconic acid
topics.inclusion_rationale: X-linked metabolic cardiomyopathy with heart-failure photographs and an echocardiogram.

topics.name: Danon Disease
clinical_manifestations: Adolescent male with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, skeletal weakness, and intellectual disability
Pigmentary retinopathy
radiological_manifestations: Echocardiography or cardiac MRI: extreme hypertrophy
Pre-excitation on ECG is supportive
pathology_manifestations: Autophagic vacuoles and absent LAMP2 immunostaining
topics.inclusion_rationale: Metabolic hypertrophy with a retinopathy photograph, extreme-wall imaging, and a LAMP2 stain.

topics.name: Exogenous Lipoid Pneumonia
clinical_manifestations: Chronic cough after mineral-oil laxative or oil-based nasal drops
The history is clinical; the image is CT
radiological_manifestations: CT: consolidation or a mass-like lesion with fat attenuation
pathology_manifestations: Lipid-laden macrophages on BAL or biopsy, oil-red-O positive
topics.inclusion_rationale: Aspiration disease with fat-attenuation CT and lipid-laden macrophages.

topics.name: Thoracic Endometriosis
clinical_manifestations: Pneumothorax or hemoptysis within 72 hours of menses
radiological_manifestations: Chest radiograph or CT: right-sided pneumothorax, diaphragmatic holes, or ground-glass hemorrhage
pathology_manifestations: Endometrial stroma and glands on pleural or diaphragmatic biopsy, often with CD10
topics.inclusion_rationale: Catamenial lung disease with a timed pneumothorax film and ectopic endometrial histology.

topics.name: Congenital Generalized Lipodystrophy
clinical_manifestations: Near-absent subcutaneous fat, prominent muscles, and acromegaloid facies from infancy
Acanthosis nigricans and hepatomegaly
radiological_manifestations: Hepatic ultrasound: severe steatosis
MRI confirms absent subcutaneous and mechanical fat
pathology_manifestations: Empty adipocytes are not biopsied routinely; AGPAT2 or BSCL2 confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: Lipodystrophy with an unmistakable body-habitus photograph. Diabetes here is a complication, not the topic.

topics.name: Familial Partial Lipodystrophy
clinical_manifestations: Loss of limb and gluteal fat with spared or increased facial and neck fat after puberty
Cushingoid appearance that is actually fat redistribution
radiological_manifestations: MRI of the thigh: absent subcutaneous fat with preserved intramuscular fat, the reverse of acquired generalized loss
pathology_manifestations: LMNA mutation in the Dunnigan type; a biopsy is not required
topics.inclusion_rationale: Partial lipodystrophy with a limb photograph and a fat-distribution MRI.

topics.name: Laron Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Severe short stature, a prominent forehead, and a small midface
Truncal obesity and a high-pitched voice are clinical; the habitus is the photograph
radiological_manifestations: Delayed bone age
Hip films may show the dysplasia of untreated severe short stature
pathology_manifestations: Low IGF-1 despite high growth hormone; GHR sequencing confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: Growth-hormone insensitivity with a photographic habitus, distinct from hypothyroidism.

topics.name: Parathyroid Carcinoma
clinical_manifestations: A palpable neck mass with very high calcium, unlike ordinary adenoma
Brown tumors and subperiosteal resorption are the bone site of the same disease, already described under primary hyperparathyroidism
radiological_manifestations: Neck ultrasound and sestamibi: a large invasive parathyroid mass
Hand radiographs: subperiosteal resorption when hyperparathyroidism is severe
pathology_manifestations: Trabecular parathyroid growth invading capsule and vessels
topics.inclusion_rationale: Parathyroid malignancy with a neck-mass photograph and an invasive sestamibi or ultrasound image.

topics.name: X-Linked Hypophosphatemic Rickets
clinical_manifestations: Bowed legs and a waddling gait in a child with a normal exam otherwise
Dental abscesses in teeth that look intact
radiological_manifestations: Knee radiographs: frayed metaphyses and bowed diaphyses out of proportion to vitamin D deficiency
pathology_manifestations: PHEX-related phosphate wasting; the growth-plate histology is rachitic
topics.inclusion_rationale: Phosphate-wasting rickets with leg photographs and metaphyseal films. Nutritional rickets stays in orthopedics.

topics.name: Juvenile Polyposis Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Endoscopy: multiple juvenile polyps in the colon or stomach
Rectal bleeding and protein-losing edema when the burden is high
radiological_manifestations: No specific radiology unless intussusception complicates a polyp; that event is not a separate topic
pathology_manifestations: Juvenile polyps with dilated cystic glands and inflamed lamina propria; SMAD4 or BMPR1A confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: Polyposis with an endoscopic gallery, distinct from familial adenomatous polyposis.

topics.name: Howel-Evans Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Focal palmoplantar keratoderma from late childhood
Endoscopy or barium study of the associated esophageal squamous carcinoma
radiological_manifestations: Barium esophagram or PET when a carcinoma has declared itself
pathology_manifestations: Callus-like keratoderma; RHBDF2 confirms the syndrome
topics.inclusion_rationale: Keratoderma-plus-esophageal-cancer syndrome with palm photographs and an esophageal image.

topics.name: Primary Intestinal Lymphangiectasia
clinical_manifestations: Edema, chylous effusions, and a child who looks malnourished despite intake
Endoscopy: snowflake white duodenal villi
radiological_manifestations: Lymphoscintigraphy or MR lymphangiography shows intestinal lymphatic leak
pathology_manifestations: Dilated mucosal lymphatics on duodenal biopsy
topics.inclusion_rationale: Lymphatic enteropathy with edema photographs, white-villus endoscopy, and dilated lymphatics on biopsy.

topics.name: Eosinophilic Gastroenteritis
clinical_manifestations: Endoscopy: thickened folds, erythema, and erosions
Ascites when the serosal layer is involved
radiological_manifestations: CT: thickened gastric or small-bowel wall and ascites
pathology_manifestations: Dense eosinophilic infiltration of mucosa, muscle, or serosa, after excluding parasite infection
topics.inclusion_rationale: Eosinophilic gut disease with endoscopic and CT images. Esophagitis remains a separate topic because the image set differs.

topics.name: Solitary Rectal Ulcer Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Rectal bleeding and mucus
Endoscopy: a solitary anterior rectal ulcer or a polypoid prolapsing fold
radiological_manifestations: Defecography: internal intussusception or prolapse
pathology_manifestations: Fibromuscular obliteration of the lamina propria
topics.inclusion_rationale: Rectal prolapse disorder with an endoscopic ulcer photograph and a defecography image.

topics.name: Pseudomembranous Colitis
clinical_manifestations: Endoscopy: raised yellow-white plaques on an erythematous mucosa
A toxic, distended abdomen in fulminant disease
radiological_manifestations: Abdominal radiograph or CT: accordion-sign colonic thickening and megacolon
pathology_manifestations: Summit lesions of pseudomembrane over necrotic epithelium; toxin assay confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: Colitis with a pathognomonic endoscopic photograph and an accordion-sign CT.

topics.name: Acute Graft-versus-Host Disease
clinical_manifestations: Maculopapular rash on the palms, soles, and trunk after transplant
Endoscopy: denuded mucosa and bile-stained exudate in gut GVHD
radiological_manifestations: CT: diffuse small-bowel wall thickening when the gut is involved
pathology_manifestations: Satellite-cell necrosis and apoptotic crypt cells; skin shows interface dermatitis with satellite necrosis
topics.inclusion_rationale: Transplant disease with skin photographs and endoscopic or histologic crypt apoptosis. The rash is a site, not a separate topic.

topics.name: Plummer-Vinson Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Koilonychia, angular cheilitis, and glossitis
Dysphagia to solids
radiological_manifestations: Barium esophagram: a proximal esophageal web
pathology_manifestations: The web is a thin mucosal shelf; iron deficiency explains the nails and mucosa
topics.inclusion_rationale: Web syndrome with nail and tongue photographs plus a barium web.

topics.name: Alagille Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Broad forehead, deep-set eyes, and a pointed chin
Chronic cholestasis with xanthomas
radiological_manifestations: Spine radiograph: butterfly vertebrae
Echocardiography: peripheral pulmonary stenosis
pathology_manifestations: Paucity of intrahepatic bile ducts; JAG1 or NOTCH2 confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: Cholestatic syndrome with a face photograph, xanthomas, butterfly vertebrae, and bile-duct paucity.

topics.name: Abetalipoproteinemia
clinical_manifestations: Failure to thrive and steatorrhea in infancy
Retinitis pigmentosa and ataxia later; the smear is the early image
radiological_manifestations: Not primarily radiologic; the acanthocyte smear and the retinal photograph are the gallery
pathology_manifestations: Enterocyte lipid vacuolization and absent apoB-containing lipoproteins
topics.inclusion_rationale: Malabsorption with acanthocytes, a lipid-filled biopsy, and later retinal photographs.

topics.name: Branchio-Oto-Renal Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Preauricular pits, branchial cleft cysts, and a cupped ear
Hearing loss is not the photograph
radiological_manifestations: Renal ultrasound: hypoplasia, agenesis, or collecting-system duplication
pathology_manifestations: EYA1 or SIX1 confirms; the branchial cyst lining is not specific
topics.inclusion_rationale: Syndrome with ear and neck photographs plus a renal ultrasound.

topics.name: Lowe Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Infantile cataracts and glaucoma
Hypotonia and areflexia
radiological_manifestations: Renal ultrasound is often bland early; rickets films appear with phosphate wasting
pathology_manifestations: OCRL enzyme or sequencing; lens histology is rarely obtained
topics.inclusion_rationale: Oculocerebrorenal disease with cataract photographs and later rachitic films.

topics.name: Bardet-Biedl Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Postaxial polydactyly, retinal dystrophy, and truncal obesity
Hypogonadism
radiological_manifestations: Renal ultrasound: cystic dysplasia or calyceal clubbing
Fundus photographs of the rod-cone dystrophy
pathology_manifestations: Ciliary gene panel; renal histology is cystic dysplasia
topics.inclusion_rationale: Ciliopathy with polydactyly, fundus photographs, and cystic-kidney imaging.

topics.name: Congenital Nephrotic Syndrome, Finnish Type
clinical_manifestations: Edema from birth and a large placenta
No hematuria requirement
radiological_manifestations: Ultrasound: enlarged echogenic kidneys
pathology_manifestations: Foot-process effacement and pseudotubular microcystic dilatation; NPHS1 confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: Neonatal nephrotic disease with edema photographs and enlarged kidneys.

topics.name: Townes-Brocks Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Satyr ear, imperforate anus, and triphalangeal or bifid thumbs
radiological_manifestations: Renal ultrasound: hypoplasia or multicystic dysplasia
Hand radiograph of the thumb malformation
pathology_manifestations: SALL1 confirms; anal and ear photographs are the clinical gallery
topics.inclusion_rationale: Syndrome with ear, thumb, and anal photographs plus renal imaging.

topics.name: Denys-Drash Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Ambiguous genitalia or a streak of male undervirilization
Early nephrotic syndrome
radiological_manifestations: Ultrasound: nephromegaly and a Wilms tumor
pathology_manifestations: Diffuse mesangial sclerosis; WT1 exon 8 or 9 mutation
topics.inclusion_rationale: WT1 syndrome with genital photographs, nephrotic onset, and a Wilms-tumor ultrasound.

topics.name: WAGR Syndrome
synonyms: Wilms tumor, aniridia, genitourinary anomalies, range of developmental delay
clinical_manifestations: Aniridia and a genital anomaly
A flank mass if Wilms tumor presents clinically
radiological_manifestations: Abdominal ultrasound or MRI of the Wilms tumor
Orbital photograph of aniridia
pathology_manifestations: 11p13 deletion including WT1 and PAX6; Wilms histology if resected
topics.inclusion_rationale: Contiguous-gene syndrome with an aniridia photograph and a Wilms imaging set.

topics.name: Senior-Loken Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Childhood polyuria and later blindness
Fundus: retinitis pigmentosa or Leber amaurosis
radiological_manifestations: Ultrasound: normal-size or small echogenic kidneys with cysts at the corticomedullary junction
pathology_manifestations: Nephronophthisis histology: tubular basement-membrane disruption
topics.inclusion_rationale: Renal-retinal ciliopathy with fundus photographs and corticomedullary cysts.

topics.name: Familial LCAT Deficiency
clinical_manifestations: Corneal opacities described as fish-eye
Proteinuria progressing to kidney failure
radiological_manifestations: No specific radiology; the slit-lamp cornea is the image
pathology_manifestations: Renal foam cells and serologic very-low HDL; LCAT sequencing confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: Lipid disorder with a slit-lamp corneal photograph and renal foam-cell histology.

topics.name: Cockayne Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Cachectic dwarfism, sunken eyes, and photosensitivity
Disproportionately small head
radiological_manifestations: CT or MRI: basal-ganglia calcification and white-matter hypomyelination
pathology_manifestations: Transcription-coupled repair defect; a skin biopsy is not routinely diagnostic
topics.inclusion_rationale: DNA-repair progeria with a face photograph and basal-ganglia calcification.

topics.name: Niemann-Pick Disease Type C
clinical_manifestations: Vertical supranuclear gaze palsy
Gelastic cataplexy and school-age cognitive loss
Neonatal cholestasis in the early-onset form
radiological_manifestations: MRI is often normal early, then shows cerebellar atrophy
pathology_manifestations: Filipin staining of unesterified cholesterol in fibroblasts; NPC1 or NPC2 confirms
topics.inclusion_rationale: Neurovisceral lipid disease whose gaze palsy and, in infants, cholestasis are the clinical images.

topics.name: LGI1-Antibody Encephalitis
clinical_manifestations: Very brief ipsilateral face and arm dystonic spasms, often filmed
Later memory loss
radiological_manifestations: MRI: temporal T2 hyperintensity or a normal scan
Hyponatremia is laboratory, not an image
pathology_manifestations: LGI1 antibodies; brain biopsy is not required
topics.inclusion_rationale: Autoimmune encephalitis identified by a filmed faciobrachial seizure and antibody testing.

topics.name: Canavan Disease
clinical_manifestations: Macrocephaly and hypotonia in early infancy
radiological_manifestations: MRI: diffuse white-matter T2 hyperintensity including the subcortical U fibers, with an elevated NAA peak on spectroscopy
pathology_manifestations: Spongy myelin vacuolization; elevated urine NAA
topics.inclusion_rationale: Leukodystrophy with macrocephaly photographs and a spectroscopy-confirmed MRI pattern.

topics.name: Zellweger Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: High forehead, large fontanelle, and severe hypotonia
Hepatomegaly and neonatal seizures
radiological_manifestations: MRI: germinolytic cysts and neuronal-migration abnormalities
Patellar and acetabular stippling on radiographs
pathology_manifestations: Absent peroxisomes and elevated very-long-chain fatty acids
topics.inclusion_rationale: Peroxisomal syndrome with a face photograph, stippled epiphyses, and a neuronal-migration MRI.

topics.name: Yellow Nail Syndrome
synonyms: yellow nail, lymphedema, and pleural effusion
clinical_manifestations: Slow-growing thick yellow nails
Lymphedema of the legs
radiological_manifestations: Chest radiograph: recurrent pleural effusions, often exudative and lymphocytic
pathology_manifestations: No specific nail histology is required; dilated lymphatics may be shown
topics.inclusion_rationale: Triad with nail and lymphedema photographs plus a pleural effusion film.

topics.name: Chronic Eosinophilic Pneumonia
clinical_manifestations: Subacute cough, fever, and wheeze in a middle-aged adult, often a woman
The photograph of the disease is the chest film
radiological_manifestations: Chest radiograph: peripheral photographic-negative-of-pulmonary-edema infiltrates
CT: upper-lobe peripheral consolidation
pathology_manifestations: BAL eosinophilia and organizing eosinophilic pneumonia on biopsy if performed
topics.inclusion_rationale: Eosinophilic pneumonia with a named radiographic pattern. Asthma alone stays excluded.

topics.name: Diffuse Pulmonary Lymphangiomatosis
clinical_manifestations: Chylous pleural effusion and chyloptysis
Wheeze from infiltrated airways
radiological_manifestations: CT: septal thickening, mediastinal infiltration, and pleural fluid
MR lymphangiography shows the leak
pathology_manifestations: Anastomosing lymphatic channels along bronchovascular bundles
topics.inclusion_rationale: Lymphatic lung disease with chylous fluid photographs and septal-thickening CT.

topics.name: Aspirin-Exacerbated Respiratory Disease
clinical_manifestations: Nasal polyps that recur after polypectomy
Aspirin-induced wheeze is a provocation, not a separate topic
radiological_manifestations: Sinus CT: expansile bilateral polyps filling the ethmoid and maxillary sinuses
pathology_manifestations: Edematous eosinophilic polyps
topics.inclusion_rationale: Airway disease with polyp photographs and a packed-sinus CT. Asthma alone stays excluded.

topics.name: Pulmonary Hyalinizing Granuloma
clinical_manifestations: Often found on a film; clubbing is uncommon
Included for the nodule photograph on CT and the histologic lamellae
radiological_manifestations: CT: bilateral well-circumscribed nodules, sometimes with calcification
pathology_manifestations: Lamellar collagen whorls, after excluding infection, vasculitis, and IgG4 disease
topics.inclusion_rationale: Nodular fibrosing lung disease with a CT gallery and a lamellar histologic image.

topics.name: Acute Eosinophilic Pneumonia
clinical_manifestations: Acute febrile hypoxic respiratory failure, often after new smoking or dust exposure
radiological_manifestations: CT: bilateral ground-glass opacity, septal lines, and pleural fluid
pathology_manifestations: BAL eosinophils above 25 percent without infection
topics.inclusion_rationale: Acute eosinophilic lung injury with a CT pattern and a BAL image. Distinct from the chronic photographic-negative form.

topics.name: Blue Rubber Bleb Nevus Syndrome
clinical_manifestations: Blue rubbery compressible skin blebs, including palms and soles
Endoscopy: similar venous malformations that bleed
radiological_manifestations: No required radiology unless a deep lesion is mapped with MRI
pathology_manifestations: Venous malformations, unlike GLUT1-positive infantile hemangioma
topics.inclusion_rationale: Venous malformation syndrome with skin and endoscopic photographs.

topics.name: Acrodermatitis Enteropathica
clinical_manifestations: Erosive, scaly plaques around the mouth, anus, and acral sites in a weanling infant
Alopecia and diarrhea
radiological_manifestations: No radiology
pathology_manifestations: Pale upper epidermis; low serum zinc and SLC39A4 confirm
topics.inclusion_rationale: Zinc dermatosis with a periorificial photograph. Ordinary nutritional deficiency without this pattern stays out.

topics.name: Pellagra
clinical_manifestations: Casal necklace and a photosensitive dermatitis on the hands and feet
Beefy red tongue
radiological_manifestations: No radiology
pathology_manifestations: No specific biopsy; the distribution photograph is the diagnosis
topics.inclusion_rationale: Niacin deficiency with a named photosensitive photograph. Included as a visual deficiency disease, not as generic malnutrition.

topics.name: Merkel Cell Carcinoma
clinical_manifestations: A rapidly growing red-violet nodule on sun-exposed skin of an older adult
radiological_manifestations: Regional nodal ultrasound or PET when staging
pathology_manifestations: Trabecular neuroendocrine tumor, CK20 perinuclear dot, Merkel-cell polyomavirus in most
topics.inclusion_rationale: Cutaneous neuroendocrine carcinoma with a nodule photograph and a CK20 immunostain.

topics.name: Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus
